finding.rationale: Operator identity resolution plus directory role-assignment enumeration (GET /roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments) answers 'who owns and administers this tenant', producing the shortlist of Global Administrator / Privileged Role Administrator holders an adversary would target for escalation or impersonation. Moving privileged directory roles to Privileged Identity Management eligible (just-in-time) assignments minimizes standing privileged accounts, so the set an adversary can discover as always-on high-value targets is small and time-bound, and each privileged activation becomes an auditable event rather than a static assignment.
